scoring_justification: The exponents z, b, λ/z are extracted from full hybrid Monte Carlo simulations that cannot be re-run in the verifier sandbox; therefore we compare the agent's reported values to the paper's reference values with tolerances and trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported critical exponents used as comparison gold
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper; solve.sh hardcodes the same numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold values are the paper's own reported measurements; they are the direct reproduction target. No synthetic labels or arbitrary numbers are used.

required.b_uniform: float (aging collapse exponent for uniform initial distribution)
required.lambda_z_uniform: float (autocorrelation decay exponent λ/z for uniform distribution)
required.b_sigma0.55: float (aging collapse exponent for σ=0.55 distribution)
required.lambda_z_sigma0.55: float (autocorrelation decay exponent λ/z for σ=0.55 distribution)

outputs.description: Critical exponents extracted from hybrid Monte Carlo / spin precession simulations of the 3D isotropic Heisenberg antiferromagnet. z from finite-size scaling of relaxation times for L=32,34,38. b and λ/z from aging scaling collapse of two-time spin autocorrelations at L=70 for uniform and σ=0.55 initial orientation distributions.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported exponents to the paper's measured values with tolerances appropriate for an independent re-implementation (different code, seeds, discretisation details). The checker also verifies the paper's qualitative claims: |b_uniform - b_sigma0.55| is small (universal b) and λ/z_sigma0.55 > λ/z_uniform (non-universal decay).

steps.description: Dynamic critical exponent z must match paper value 1.392 within ±0.10
Aging collapse exponent b for uniform initial distribution must match paper value 0.75 within ±0.10
Decay exponent λ/z for uniform distribution must match paper value 1.08 within ±0.15
Aging collapse exponent b for σ=0.55 distribution must match paper value 0.77 within ±0.10
Decay exponent λ/z for σ=0.55 distribution must match paper value 1.16 within ±0.15
